7.1.3.2.2 Response
The completion of each response transmission is notified to the LIN Interface. The LIN
Driver confirms a successfully transmitted response to the LIN Interface with the re-
sponse confirmation callback function LinIf_TxConfirmation and an unsuccessful
response with the error indication callback function LinIf_LinErrorIndication.

[SWS_LinIf_00847] ⌈If LinIf_HeaderIndication is called while the confirmation
of a response transmission is expected, the LIN Interface shall consider the transmitted
frame as lost. Therefore, the LIN Interface shall report the runtime error code LINIF_-
E_RESPONSE to the Default Error Trace
